text:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Canary anomaly detected in us-west-2 on embedding route. error-rate 5.8% over 5m; p99 latency jumped from ~220ms -> ~3.2s. Affected: hosted API embed endpoint (+ some Dedicated customers using default routing). Paging on-call.
Sam (oncall): ack — I'm on it. @Alex R can you grab canary logs and confirm traffic split?
Alex R: on it. hitting admin and k8s now. curl to admin shows traffic_split=10% for model openlm-embed-v2-canary.
Alex R: running log tail now: 
```
$ kubectl logs -n inference deploy/serve-embed-canary --since=15m | tail -n 60
[...snip...]
2026-03-10T16:18:22Z ERROR downstream request failed status=500 err=model_infer_error kernel:cu_memcpy_async failed
2026-03-10T16:18:23Z ERROR inference request id=abc123 path=/v1/embed status=500 user=svc-search
2026-03-10T16:19:05Z WARN pod/serve-embed-canary-7 OOMKilled
```
Maria L: I'm seeing repeated OOMs on canary pods and some CUDA driver errors in the node dmesg. Patterns around long sequence inputs (~>1024 tokens) look suspect.
Sam (oncall): Product — any visible customer impact metrics? @Priya (Product)
Priya (Product): We're seeing degraded embed responses for ~30 customers (errors + slow tails). Search-ranking background jobs retried; a handful of customers' nightly batch jobs failed. No billing impact yet. Customer tickets started coming in ~16:25 UTC.
Alex R: quick timeline from logs:
- 16:09 deploy pipeline pushed canary image openlm-embed-v2:2026-03-10-quant and set traffic_split=10%
- 16:12 first 5xxs show up in canary logs
- 16:17 error-rate climbs to 3% then 5% by 16:22
- 16:22 k8s autoscaler spun extra canary pods but new pods OOM at startup
- 16:30 routing fallback lagged; hosted API still routed a small fraction to canary until manual pause
Sam (oncall): Hypotheses: 1) new quantization build has memory regression on long sequences causing OOM/500s. 2) config change (batch_size/concurrency) combined with kv-cache is pushing GPU memory beyond limit. Need model config diff + rollout config. @Jen K can you check whether version pinning or dedicated customer routing was respected?
Jen K: checked routing config. Rollout script set traffic_split: 10% for model id openlm-embed-v2:2026-03-10-quant. Stable is openlm-embed-v2:2026-02-28. No per-customer pinning found for hosted traffic; Dedicated customers explicitly pinned to stable should be unaffected but need verification.
Alex R: pulled model metadata diffs — snippet: 
```yaml
# model-metadata.yaml diff
- allocator: cuda_pinned
+ allocator: cuda_managed
- default_batch_size: 8
+ default_batch_size: 16
- quantization: int8_dynamic
+ quantization: int8_static
```
Maria L: that allocator change + increased batch size would explain more GPU memory pressure. int8_static requires memory for calibration tables in GPU at load time — could be the spike.
Sam (oncall): Mitigation proposal: immediately pause canary traffic (set traffic_split=0%), scale down canary pods, and rollback model image to previous quant-safe build. If pause works and error-rate returns to baseline, notify customers and proceed with RCA. Any objections? :thinking_face:
Alex R: no objections. I'll pause via admin API now.
Alex R: run: 
```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  https://admin.redwood.internal/rollouts/pause \
  -d '{"model":"openlm-embed-v2-canary"}'
```
Ops Bot: action: traffic_split changed -> 0% for openlm-embed-v2-canary by Alex R.
Sam (oncall): monitoring -> error-rate dropping in last 4m, p99 back to ~260ms. Looks like pause helped. @Priya please prepare customer comms for impacted folks.
Priya (Product): starting draft: "We observed intermittent 5xxs and increased latency on embed endpoints due to a canary rollout. We've paused the canary and are investigating. We're raising support tickets and will follow up with timeline and mitigation."
Jen K: RCA checklist for in-thread tracking:
- collect canary pod logs + kernel traces (Alex)
- upload model artifacts and sha256 (Alex)
- verify Dedicated customer pins and notify SEs (Sam + Priya)
- reproduce with long-seq test harness (Maria + ML infra)
- check rollout pipeline preflight tests skipped? (Jen)
- confirm autoscaler/oom interactions (Eng Infra)
Alex R: logs and artifacts uploaded to internal share: https://share.internal/r/incident-2543216789 (logs.tar.gz + model-artifacts/sha256: abcdef1234567890)
Maria L: I reproduced locally with seq len 2048 and batch=16 — model binary exceeded GPU memory and caused CUDA allocation errors. Repro is consistent.
Sam (oncall): decision: rollback canary image to last-known-good and require stricter preflight before re-rollout. Rollback queued.
Alex R: issuing rollback now via pipeline: setting image -> openlm-embed-v2:2026-02-28 and traffic_split=0.
Ops Bot: action: rollback initiated by Alex R; new image tag applied to canary deployment.
Sam (oncall): post-mitigation check: error-rate at baseline for 15m, no new OOMs in cluster. Customer impact summary: ~30 customers transiently affected; SEs notified; tickets open.
Priya (Product): escalating to customer success for targeted outreach to 5 top customers who observed retries in production.
Jen K: taking ownership of RCA. I'll run memory profile, coordinate with ML infra to add a preflight that runs long-seq mem checks and validate allocator choices. Proposed gating: require memory headroom > 30% across sequence length distribution and disable static quantization without QA sign-off.
Sam (oncall): handoff to Jen for full postmortem. Severity set to Sev2. I'll close the pager for oncall but remain available for questions.
Alex R: one action item: add a guard in the rollout pipeline to block traffic_split changes unless model metadata passes the 'memory check' job.
Jen K: scheduling RCA meeting for tomorrow 09:30 UTC. Will post notes + timeline + final action items in incidents channel.
Sam (oncall): thanks team — nice quick mitigation. :thumbsup:
Maria L: adding one more note — check node driver version mismatch; some nodes reported driver warnings concurrently, might be compounding factor.
Alex R: noted. I'll correlate node-driver versions and include in RCA.
Jen K: I will own the follow-up. tagging: @Sam (oncall) @Alex R @Maria L @Priya (Product).
